Italy U17 vs Burkina Faso U17: Watch Live Stream Online - FIFA U-17 World Cup 21.11.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of a Round of 16 match in the FIFA U-17 World Cup, where one of the tournament favorites, the Italy national team, will face the champions of Africa, the Burkina Faso national team. This is a classic clash between the tactical European school and athletic African football.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 21, 2025, 13:30 UTC (16:30 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Italian national team confidently navigated the group stage, showcasing a very mature and tactically astute style of football. The 'Azzurrini' finished first in their group, displaying one of the most solid defensive lines in the tournament. The Italians rely on ball control, game organization, and quick transitions from defense to attack. In their final group stage match, Italy secured a convincing victory to ensure their top spot in the playoffs.

The Burkina Faso national team made it to the knockout stage by finishing second in their group. The African champions, as expected, have demonstrated an athletic, powerful, and fast-paced style of football. The main strength of the African team is their physical power and the individual actions of their attacking players. However, during the group stage, the team's issues with consistency and tactical discipline became apparent, which could be a decisive factor against a well-organized opponent like Italy.

Head-to-Head History

There have been no previous official meetings between these youth national teams. This will be their first-ever head-to-head encounter.

Italy U17 vs Burkina Faso U17 Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider the Italian national team the clear favorite for the upcoming match. Their tactical training, game organization, and superior class should be decisive factors. Burkina Faso will try to impose a physical battle and use their speed in counter-attacks, but that may not be enough.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for Italy U17. The 'Azzurrini' are expected to control the course of the game and should secure a win through their organization and class.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering the solid defense of the Italian team and the fact that teams often play cautiously in knockout matches, a bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' seems logical.
  • Key Factor: The tactical discipline and game organization of Italy versus the physical power and individual skill of Burkina Faso.

Tune into the Italy U17 vs Burkina Faso U17 live stream on tutsport.net and follow the decisive playoff games at the FIFA U-17 World Cup!

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the most anticipated quarter-final matches of the FIFA U-17 World Cup in Qatar, featuring two magnificent teams - the Africa U-17 Cup of Nations finalist, Morocco, and one of the main tournament favorites, Brazil. This is a battle of tactical discipline versus attacking flair.

Kick-off: November 21, 2025, 15:45 UTC (18:45 MSK) Stadium: Education City Stadium, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup, Quarter-final

Morocco U17 vs Brazil U17: Match Preview

Both teams have confidently navigated the previous knockout stages and will now determine in a head-to-head clash who will advance to the semi-finals. Morocco has been the main revelation of the tournament, displaying an incredibly organized defense. The 'Atlas Lion Cubs' have yet to concede a single goal in this World Cup, winning all their matches, including their Round of 16 tie. Brazil, on the other hand, has steamrolled their opponents, playing an exciting and high-scoring brand of football. This will be the first-ever official meeting between these two nations at the U-17 level.

Team Form and Analysis

Morocco U17

Saïd Chiba's team has impressed everyone with their tactical astuteness and impenetrable defense. The Moroccans rely on compactness, strict discipline, and fast counter-attacks. Not conceding a single goal in four World Cup matches is a phenomenal achievement. The Moroccan defense will face its ultimate test against the tournament's strongest attack.

Brazil U17

The 'Seleção' are traditionally among the main favorites in any tournament. The team plays an exciting, technical, and very high-scoring style of football, averaging several goals per game. The Brazilians are packed with talent, with many players already on the radar of top European clubs. The main question is whether the Brazilian wonderkids can break down the best defense in the tournament.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Morocco U17 (4-1-4-1): Benarba; Zahouani, Bakou, Agoumi, El Hannach; Ait Boudalal; Maâli, Nazih, Hamout, Alaoui; Ennair.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This is a classic clash between the best attack and the best defense of the tournament. Brazil is the favorite on paper due to their incredible selection of attacking players. However, Morocco's phenomenal organization makes them an extremely dangerous opponent.

  • Main Prediction: Brazil to Qualify. Despite all the difficulties the Moroccan defense will create, the individual class of the Brazilian forwards should be the deciding factor. The victory might be secured in extra time.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. This is a meeting of the best attack and the best defense. Morocco has not conceded in the tournament, and it is unlikely they will allow the Brazilians to run riot. A tight, tactical battle is expected.

Mainz 05 vs Hoffenheim: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 11th round of the German Bundesliga, where Mainz 05 hosts Hoffenheim at their MEWA Arena. This is a clash between two teams from opposite ends of the league table: the hosts are in a desperate fight for survival, while the visitors aim to solidify their position in the European qualification zone.

Kick-off: November 21, 2025, 19:30 UTC (22:30 MSK) Stadium: MEWA Arena, Mainz Competition: Bundesliga

Mainz 05 vs Hoffenheim: Match Preview

The teams approach this match in different moods. Mainz is in a deep crisis, sitting in the penultimate 17th place in the table. The 'Carnival Club' has only managed one victory in the opening ten rounds, collecting just five points. Hoffenheim, on the other hand, is having an excellent season, currently in 6th place, which grants a spot in European competitions. Despite the difference in form, the recent head-to-head history favors Mainz, who have won six of the last nine encounters. Interestingly, last season, the teams exchanged 2-0 home victories.

Team Form and Analysis

Mainz 05

Bo Henriksen's team is experiencing one of the worst starts in its history. Mainz's main problem is their weak attack; the team struggles significantly with creating and converting chances. In the last round, the 'Carnival Club' lost 1-0 away to Eintracht Frankfurt, registering an expected goals (xG) of just 0.16. In a match against a strong opponent, the hosts will need a miracle to break their dreadful streak and climb out of the relegation zone.

Hoffenheim

The 'Villagers,' under Christian Ilzer, are showing consistent results and are deservedly among the leading group. The team relies on a solid defense and fast counter-attacks. Hoffenheim's squad features a group of talented attacking players led by veteran Andrej Kramarić, who can cause problems for any defense. The visitors will be looking to secure three points to strengthen their position in the race for European spots.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Mainz (3-4-3): Zentner; van den Berg, Bell, Fernandes; Widmer, Barreiro, Kohr, Caci; Gruda, Ajorque, Lee Jae-sung.
  • Hoffenheim (3-5-2): Baumann; Kabak, Brooks, Vogt; Kadeřábek, Prömel, Stach, Kramarić, Skov; Weghorst, Beier.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Mainz is playing at home and has a good recent head-to-head record, Hoffenheim currently looks like the clear favorite. Their current form and stability should be decisive in a match against a team in a deep crisis.

  • Main Prediction: Hoffenheim to Win. The visitors are in excellent form and should defeat one of the league's underdogs to continue their fight for the top spots.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Mainz has serious problems with scoring, and Hoffenheim is likely to play pragmatically away from home. 4 of the last 5 head-to-head meetings have been low-scoring. A tight contest with a small number of goals is expected.

Nice vs Olympique Marseille: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the Derby de la Côte d'Azur, one of the most intense and heated rivalries in French Ligue 1, where OGC Nice hosts Olympique de Marseille at their Allianz Riviera stadium. This is a clash between two teams from the top half of the table, both competing for European spots.

Kick-off: November 21, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK) Stadium: Allianz Riviera, Nice Competition: Ligue 1

Nice vs Olympique Marseille: Match Preview

The teams approach the derby in contrasting form. Marseille sits second in the league, just two points behind PSG, and is currently on a three-game unbeaten streak. Nice, on the other hand, has suffered three consecutive defeats in all competitions after a strong start to the season, dropping to ninth place. Despite this, 'The Eaglets' are traditionally formidable at home, where they are unbeaten in their last five Ligue 1 matches and have won their last two home derbies against Marseille.

Team Form and Analysis

Nice

'The Eaglets' will be highly motivated to end their losing streak in the derby in front of their home fans. The team relies on a solid defense, but this model has faltered in recent matches. The situation is worsened by significant injury problems: key defender Dante and midfielder Youssouf Ndayishimiye will miss the match.

Olympique Marseille

The 'Phocéens' are in excellent form and boast the best attack in the league, having scored 28 goals. The team will be looking to secure three points to continue their pursuit of the league title. However, Marseille has been inconsistent on the road - all three of their defeats this season have come in away matches.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Nice (4-3-3): Bulka; Lotomba, Todibo, Rosario, Bard; Sanson, Thuram, Boga; Laborde, Moffi, Cho.
  • Marseille (3-4-3): Lopez; Mbemba, Balerdi, Murillo; Clauss, Veretout, Gueye, Lodi; Sarr, Aubameyang, Greenwood.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Marseille is in better form, Nice is an extremely dangerous opponent at home, especially in a derby. The history of recent meetings at the Allianz Riviera and Marseille's struggles in away games make the teams' chances almost even.

  • Main Prediction: Nice to Win or Draw (1X). 'The Eaglets' have won four of their last five home games in Ligue 1 and very rarely lose to Marseille on their home turf. Given the visitors' unstable away form, the hosts should at least avoid defeat.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Three of the last four head-to-head meetings between these teams have been low-scoring. The derby is likely to be tense and not very high-scoring.

Valencia vs Levante: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the main Valencian derby ('Derbi de la ciudad de Valencia'), where Valencia hosts its fiercest rival, the newly-promoted Levante, at their legendary Mestalla stadium. This is one of the hottest and most unpredictable rivalries in Spanish football, always characterized by high tension.

Kick-off: November 21, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Mestalla, Valencia Competition: La Liga

Valencia vs Levante: Match Preview

The teams approach the derby with different objectives. Valencia is a solid mid-table team competing for a spot in European competitions. Levante, on the other hand, is in a desperate fight for survival after their return to La Liga. Despite the difference in status, a derby always has a life of its own. The head-to-head history at Mestalla favors Valencia, who have won 10 of the last 12 home derbies. However, matches between these teams are almost always very high-scoring.

Team Form and Analysis

Valencia

'The Bats,' under Rubén Baraja, rely on fast counter-attacks and set pieces. At Mestalla, with the support of their fans, Valencia is particularly formidable. The team will be looking to prove their superiority in the city and secure a crucial three points. The leader of Valencia's attack is striker Hugo Duro.

Levante

The 'Frogs' ('Granotas') will be highly motivated for the match against their main enemy. The team will focus on a tight defense and will try to use their chances on the counter. Despite being the underdogs, Levante has proven more than once that they can take points from Valencia, especially in high-scoring matches.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Valencia (4-4-2): Mamardashvili; Correia, Mosquera, Özkacar, Gayà; Fran Pérez, Pepelu, Guerra, López; Duro, Yaremchuk.
  • Levante (5-3-2): Femenías; Pubill, Dela, Postigo, Muñoz, Valle; Kocho, Lozano, Romero; Bouldini, Fabrício.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the intensity of the derby, Valencia are the clear favorites at home. Their superiority in class and their daunting home record against Levante make a victory for 'The Bats' the most likely outcome.

  • Main Prediction: Valencia to Win. 'The Bats' should defeat their rivals, who are inferior in class, on their home turf.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. The Valencian derby is one of the most high-scoring in Spain. The last 12 head-to-head meetings have all seen three or more goals scored. An open game with plenty of goals is expected.

Atlético CP vs Benfica: Live Stream of the Cup Match

On Friday, November 21, 2025, the Taça de Portugal will feature an intriguing clash as the modest Atlético CP hosts one of the nation's giants, SL Benfica. Matches like these are the very essence of cup competitions, where an underdog gets a chance to make history. We invite you to watch the online stream of this encounter exclusively on tutsport.net. The live broadcast will begin at 20:30 UTC (23:30 MSK).

For Atlético CP, this match is the main event of the season. To share the pitch with Benfica is a huge motivation for every player. The hosts will undoubtedly give their all and try to perform at their maximum. Their tactics will be clear: extremely disciplined team defense and hope for rare counter-attacks or set pieces. Atlético's main task will be to contain the opponent's powerful attacking line for as long as possible.

Benfica approaches this match as the absolute favorite. For the Lisbon Eagles, this is an opportunity to advance to the next round, possibly by rotating their squad and giving reserve players a chance to shine. However, there will be no underestimation of the opponent, as upsets are a regular occurrence in the Taça de Portugal. Benfica is expected to seize the initiative from the first minutes and systematically break down the hosts' defense in search of the opening goal.

This match is a classic cup story where order and dedication can challenge class and skill. Can Atlético CP perform a miracle in front of their home fans? Or will Benfica confidently confirm their status? Our live stream will provide answers to all these questions and allow you to enjoy the atmosphere of a true cup battle.

  • Competition: Taça de Portugal (Cup of Portugal)
  • Teams: Atlético CP vs Benfica
  • Date: November 21, 2025
  • Kick-off Time: 20:30 (UTC) / 23:30 (MSK)
  • Live on: Exclusive broadcast on tutsport.net

Join the online broadcast of the Atlético CP vs Benfica match on tutsport.net and witness this exciting cup duel!
